sources.title: Wan2.2-S2V-14B · Models
sources.snippet: 👍 Efficient High-Definition Hybrid TI2V: Wan2.2 open-sources a 5B model built with our advanced Wan2.2-VAE that achieves a compression ratio of 16×16×4. This model supports both text-to-video and image-to-video generation at 720P resolution with 24fps and can also run on consumer-grade graphics cards like 4090.

sources.title: Wan2.2-S2V-14B: Audio-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Wan2.2-S2V-14B Practical Guide Overview Wan2.2-S2V-14B is an audio-driven video generation model that produces cinematic-quality videos synchronized to audio input, developed by Wan-AI. The model generates videos at 480P and 720P resolutions with 24fps output, driven by a 14-billion parameter architecture built on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) foundation.
